<action>
<reasoning>The user wants a temperature conversion. Formula: F = C × 9/5 + 32. 25 × 9/5 = 45, plus 32 = 77.</reasoning>
<tool>agent.finish</tool>
<content>25°C equals 77°F.</content>
</action>
Find my notes about the Phoenix project.

<action>
<reasoning>The user wants to find existing notes. I should search their resources for 'Phoenix project'.</reasoning>
<tool>resource.search</tool>
<query>Phoenix project</query>
</action>

<action>
<reasoning>The search returned two matching notes. I will present them concisely.</reasoning>
<tool>agent.finish</tool>
<content>Found 2 notes: "Phoenix Project - Week 3" and "Phoenix retro notes".</content>
</action>
Create a note titled 'Meeting Agenda' with the text: Review Q3 roadmap and assign owners.

<action>
<reasoning>The user wants to create a new note. This is a mutation, so I must request confirmation before executing resource.create_note.</reasoning>
<tool>agent.request_confirmation</tool>
<summary>Create note "Meeting Agenda"</summary>
<operation>Create a text note with title "Meeting Agenda" containing the agenda items.</operation>
<pending_tool>resource.create_note</pending_tool>
</action>

<action>
